items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Louie Warnick was their manager. ... After Louie Warnick died, the band broke up.

ctx.x: Who else was in that band beside Peter?
They had, uh, Peter Bocais, Charlie Bocais, Henry Bocais. Louie Warnick was their manager. And, uh, this boy plays with, uh, with George Williams drums now.
